The main subject is a large subwoofer box on the left with two prominent silver-rimmed circular drivers stacked vertically. To the right are three smaller satellite speakers, each featuring multiple drivers. Small black rectangular objects (possibly remotes or stands) lie in front of the satellites. A faint logo is visible on the top front edge of the subwoofer.
